review_policy: Status implemented means the cited test exists and exercises the denial today. Status planned is an honest gap: the row keeps its owner and review_expiry so it cannot silently disappear. A planned row is not PASS.

rows.threat: Agent Goal Hijack: injected content redirects the agent from the owner-declared goal or widens its authority.
rows.required_control: Treat retrieved/tool/page text as data; bind actions to a human-issued, scope- and argument-bound confirmation; reject injection text that claims approval.
rows.expected_denial: Injection text in args neither mints a confirmation nor widens scope (CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED / CONFIRMATION_SOURCE_FORBIDDEN).

rows.threat: Tool Misuse and Exploitation: an agent invokes a tool outside its grant or the tool executes without policy validation.
rows.required_control: Deny-by-default ToolGateway allowlist, exact tool names (no wildcard), dry-run preview and a typed refusal before any executor call.
rows.expected_denial: BUSINESS_TOOL_NOT_ALLOWED with zero executor calls.

rows.threat: Identity and Privilege Abuse: an actor reads or mutates another tenant's or business's records.
rows.required_control: Tenant-scoped storage and queries; every lookup and invocation carries tenant_id/business_id; deny wins.
rows.expected_denial: BUSINESS_NOT_FOUND for a business outside the caller's tenant, with zero executor calls.

rows.threat: Agentic Supply Chain: a dependency with an absent or unverified license is treated as approved code.
rows.required_control: Machine-readable dependency lock; a license that is absent or plan-recorded cannot be approved/imported; paid art stays local.
rows.expected_denial: UNAPPROVED_REUSE when an absent-license concept row claims approved.

rows.threat: Unexpected Code Execution: generated code escapes the sandbox or reads host sockets, tokens or world-readable paths.
rows.required_control: Per-call sandbox directory lockdown, owner-only remote writes and no RPC token on the command line.
rows.expected_denial: Sandbox dirs and remote writes are owner-only; the RPC token never rides argv.

rows.threat: Memory and Context Poisoning: a memory written by one agent or scope is retrieved by another.
rows.required_control: Per-seat/tenant memory scopes; cross-scope retrieval denied; event log authoritative and projection rebuildable.
rows.expected_denial: A memory written for one seat never returns to another seat.

rows.threat: Insecure Inter-Agent Communication: a non-human source, spoofed sender or replayed message acquires authority.
rows.required_control: Human-only confirmation issuer; source-authenticated execution; replay/expiry/target binding; typed refusal for model/automation sources.
rows.expected_denial: CONFIRMATION_SOURCE_FORBIDDEN for model/automation sources, and issuance by a non-human raises ConfirmationDenied.

rows.threat: Cascading Failures: runaway cost, duplicate side effects or a retry storm exhausts budget/quota and starves other work.
rows.required_control: Per-business budget and policy cost cap refused before execution; idempotency key yields one effect.
rows.expected_denial: BUSINESS_BUDGET_EXCEEDED before the executor runs.

rows.threat: Human-Agent Trust Exploitation: an approval for one payload, target or moment is replayed for another.
rows.required_control: Approval bound to canonical payload hash, target/args and expiry; single use; a changed payload or stale window is refused.
rows.expected_denial: REPLAYED_CONFIRMATION, TARGET_MISMATCH and EXPIRED_CONFIRMATION are all refused.

rows.threat: Rogue Agents: a compromised or runaway agent keeps acting after the owner stops it.
rows.required_control: Fail-closed emergency stop checked before execution; revocation of the broker/lease path.
rows.expected_denial: The broker denies before execution while the stop is engaged.

rows.threat: Cross-tenant/room/department leakage.
rows.required_control: Tenant-scoped records and queries; cross-tenant lookups fail closed.
rows.expected_denial: BUSINESS_NOT_FOUND for the foreign tenant.

rows.threat: Secret leakage into prompts, logs, memory, workspaces, artifacts or receipts.
rows.required_control: Redaction at the boundary; secret-shaped text masked in logs and receipts.
rows.expected_denial: Quoted JSON secrets are masked rather than emitted.

rows.threat: Approval confusion / TOCTOU: an approval for one request is used for a different request.
rows.required_control: Approval request keyed by canonical payload hash; reusing the key with a changed payload is refused.
rows.expected_denial: BUSINESS_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT when the same approval key carries a different payload.

rows.threat: Approve payload A, execute payload B: the gateway accepts an approval whose canonical payload differs from the invocation.
rows.required_control: At execution time, compare the approval's request_hash (or an equivalent canonical intent hash) with the invocation request_hash and refuse a mismatch.
rows.expected_denial: A typed refusal when the invocation payload does not match the approved payload.

rows.threat: MCP OAuth: an OAuth-required server is treated as connected without a cached token or login.
rows.required_control: Typed login-required park for an enabled OAuth entry with no token; no silent downgrade to unauthenticated use.
rows.expected_denial: The server is reported login-required instead of connected.

rows.threat: MCP tool poisoning / schema-flip: a server changes a tool definition or description after approval.
rows.required_control: Hash the complete tool definition (inputSchema, outputSchema, annotations) and require review when it changes.
rows.expected_denial: A changed schema/description is refused or parked for human review.

rows.threat: SSRF/network exfiltration: a tool or web fetch reaches loopback, private, link-local or cloud-metadata addresses.
rows.required_control: Block private/loopback/link-local/metadata destinations and refuse a redirect into them.
rows.expected_denial: BLOCKED_HOST for private, loopback, link-local and metadata URLs.

rows.threat: Sandbox escape or host compromise from generated code.
rows.required_control: Owner-only sandbox directories, no token on argv, bounded remote writes.
rows.expected_denial: The sandbox cannot be read by other users and the RPC token is absent from argv.

rows.threat: Memory poisoning or cross-scope retrieval.
rows.required_control: Per-seat memory scope with cross-scope denial.
rows.expected_denial: Another agent cannot read the seat's memory.

rows.threat: A2A spoof/replay: an unauthenticated or replayed agent message is accepted as authority.
rows.required_control: Authenticated/signed typed messages, recipient ACL, replay protection and human-only authority transfer.
rows.expected_denial: A spoofed sender or replayed message is refused and confers no capability.

rows.threat: Kill switch fails to stop scheduler, gateway calls, leases or egress.
rows.required_control: Fail-closed emergency stop checked before execution.
rows.expected_denial: Denied before execution while the stop is engaged.

rows.threat: Observability leaks secrets or PII into logs, receipts or exported telemetry.
rows.required_control: Redact before export; content capture off by default.
rows.expected_denial: Quoted secrets are masked in log events and receipts.

rows.threat: Backup/restore failure or a restore that cannot reproduce the tenant state.
rows.required_control: Encrypted backup, restore round-trip and tamper/wrong-passphrase refusal.
rows.expected_denial: A wrong passphrase or tampered backup is a typed refusal; the round-trip restores state.

rows.threat: Inaccessible UI: keyboard, focus, contrast or non-color status requirements are absent.
rows.required_control: Accessibility primitives (focus, contrast, non-color status) enforced by the static frontend gate; manual WCAG review remains a release task.
rows.expected_denial: A page/style set that drops the accessibility primitives fails the static gate.

rows.threat: Paid LimeZu art or archives leak into the public tree, bundle, export or theme directory.
rows.required_control: No archives/executables under the office public tree; no theme art under committed theme directories.
rows.expected_denial: The asset gate fails if a paid archive or executable appears under the public tree.
